name: What is the typical timeline for kitchen countertop installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for kitchen countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical timeline for kitchen countertop installation can range from 1 to 3 weeks, depending on the material and project scope. After material selection, templating usually takes place within a few days. Fabrication can take 5-10 business days. Installation itself often takes 1-2 days. Custom orders or unusual materials may extend this timeframe. We strive to communicate clear timelines throughout the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation timelines usually range from 1 to 3 weeks, including templating, fabrication, and installation.
